column1: # While LEARN is on, the macro tokens that flow into learn_buffer are
# also streamed to a sidecar file as one JSON record per token. The
# sidecar is replayable via app.replay_sidecar (and via the
# `l123 --replay` CLI flag) — the regression-test harness for
# This transcript records a session, wipes the workbook, replays the
# sidecar, and asserts the end state matches the pre-wipe state.
# Stash a sidecar path inside the sandbox. Production derives this
# from active_path; the test bypass keeps the test free of /File Save.
# /WLR — set the learn range at B1..B3 (the cells where macro source
# also lands on flush). The sidecar is the streaming counterpart.
# Pointer back to A1 for the recording.
# Alt-F5: arm recording. LEARN indicator lights and the sidecar opens.
# Recorded keystrokes: 10 ENTER DOWN 20 ENTER → A1=10, A2=20.
# Sanity-check the recording landed in the worksheet.
# Sanity-check the sidecar exists and carries JSON tokens. compact
# serde_json (no spaces) writes `{"keys":"1"}` per line, etc.
# Wipe the workbook — clears all cells; pointer back to A1.
# Replay the sidecar. Tokens dispatch through the macro interpreter
# (run_macro_text) → handle_key, just like LEARN's playback path.
# Post-replay state matches the pre-wipe state.
